title: Implement compute(a, b) arithmetic mean feature in src/main.py with helper and tests
description:
Implement a Python feature that computes the arithmetic mean of two finite numeric inputs.

Requirements:
- Define compute(a, b) in src/main.py returning the arithmetic mean of two finite numeric inputs. Example: compute(2, 3) must return 2.5.
- Support zero, negative and fractional values.
- Implement mean_values(a, b) in src/helper.py and import/use it in src/main.py.
- Write tests/test_compute.py with a unittest checking compute(2, 3) == 2.5.
- All three files (src/main.py, src/helper.py, tests/test_compute.py) are required.
- Validate with the public behavioral check (checks/public_check.py) and build via Python bytecode compilation of src.
